insights:
Analysis of Dataset and Findings

The dataset includes a total of 13,896 events across 104 event types from November 27, 2025 to February 19, 2026. The analysis of friction points in the workflow has identified several events with high repetition rates.

Top 3 Friction Points

  • Event: viewed_hisab_page
    Repetition Rate: 43.4% (5,720 total occurrences)
    • OPERATIONAL IMPACT: The high repetition indicates that operators are likely spending additional time reloading or revisiting this page, potentially wasting significant time per session.
    • PROBABLE CAUSE: This could be due to slow loading times or a lack of clarity on whether the page has loaded successfully.
    • SOLUTION: Optimize the page load speed and implement a loading indicator to inform operators that the page is processing.
  • Event: home_page_load_error
    Repetition Rate: 40.8% (206 total occurrences)
    • OPERATIONAL IMPACT: Operators may be wasting time attempting to reload the home page after encountering errors, leading to frustration and delays.
    • PROBABLE CAUSE: This may stem from server issues or network instability causing the home page to fail to load properly.
    • SOLUTION: Improve server reliability and provide error messages with guidance on how to proceed after a load error.
  • Event: login_send_otp_failed
    Repetition Rate: 31.2% (16 total occurrences)
    • OPERATIONAL IMPACT: Repeated attempts to send OTPs can lead to delays in logging in, impacting overall efficiency.
    • PROBABLE CAUSE: This could be due to issues with the OTP service or user input errors.
    • SOLUTION: Enhance the OTP sending mechanism and provide clear feedback on the status of the OTP request.

Addressing these friction points will significantly enhance the efficiency of the bus operator's workflow and reduce wasted time due to repetitive actions.
